name: write_logic
description: Write a generic logic value to a device using a logic-type name or numeric ID. Any device in the world that supports writing that type; a gateway_id limits it to devices on that gateway's data networks. Returns requested_value, previous_value and current_value: current_value is read back at once and can differ from the request, because the device clamps it (On 7 reads 1), ignores it (a paint-only colour index), or moves toward it over time (a solar panel's angle); the write still succeeds.

reference_id.description: Target device reference ID returned by list_devices.

logic_type.description: LogicType enum name or numeric ushort ID.
